scope: Required completion contract; existing controlled fixtures alone do not satisfy it.

cells.behavior: Search, follow and compare multiple pages
cells.independent_outcome: Exact text, table and link facts with canonical URLs; persisted request sequence

cells.behavior: Pagination and asynchronous refresh in a dynamic frontend
cells.independent_outcome: Exact facts after each refresh and page transition

cells.behavior: Same-origin, cross-origin and nested-frame extraction
cells.independent_outcome: Expected frame facts; no foreign or detached document leakage

cells.behavior: Empty results, missing sources and redirects
cells.independent_outcome: Exact empty/error outcomes and redirect request history

cells.behavior: Stale semantic references across navigation and refresh
cells.independent_outcome: Reject stale actions; reacquire current references without leaking old facts

cells.behavior: Multi-step native and custom controls with text, options, dates and numbers
cells.independent_outcome: Exact ordered receipt fields and Unicode values

cells.behavior: Asynchronous validation with required, invalid and disabled controls
cells.independent_outcome: No receipt on rejected input; successful corrected receipt

cells.behavior: GET, POST and multipart submission with real authorized file upload
cells.independent_outcome: Exact request method, body, field order and uploaded byte hashes

cells.behavior: Submitter overrides and cancel behavior
cells.independent_outcome: Exact submitter action/method; no receipt for cancellation

cells.behavior: Cancelled and reentrant submission, navigation and retry
cells.independent_outcome: One authorized receipt; no duplicate external write

cells.behavior: File and secret confinement across contexts
cells.independent_outcome: Only authorized upload bytes; no secret or file leakage

cells.behavior: Hydrated or client-rendered search, filters, comparison and variants
cells.independent_outcome: Exact chosen variant and server quote

cells.behavior: Persistent cart and quantities across route changes and reload
cells.independent_outcome: Exact persisted cart items and quantities

cells.behavior: Quote, review and controlled checkout
cells.independent_outcome: Exact persisted order, total and inventory; one accepted mutation

cells.behavior: Declared framed payment-style flow
cells.independent_outcome: Controlled payment receipt attributed to the correct cart and order

cells.behavior: Asynchronous stock/price changes and stale-quote recovery
cells.independent_outcome: Reject old quote; review and accept current price/stock exactly once

cells.behavior: Duplicate checkout and retry after interruption
cells.independent_outcome: One durable order and one inventory decrement

cells.behavior: Authenticated SPA login/SSO through a controlled cross-origin identity provider
cells.independent_outcome: Real authorization-code/PKCE token exchange and exact authorization history

cells.behavior: Authorized MFA handoff and resume
cells.independent_outcome: Authentication completes only after authorized challenge response

cells.behavior: Create, read, update and reload authenticated records
cells.independent_outcome: Exact persisted record, version and authorization history

cells.behavior: Logout, session expiry and relogin
cells.independent_outcome: Correct session state; denied expired writes; restored authorized session

cells.behavior: State, redirect, verifier, replay and expiry validation
cells.independent_outcome: Reject each invalid exchange without issuing an authorized session

cells.behavior: Stale and duplicate saves with interruption and retry
cells.independent_outcome: Exact version history and one accepted write

cells.behavior: Unauthorized writes, context isolation and redaction
cells.independent_outcome: No cross-context access or secret disclosure; exact denied-write history

cells.behavior: Client datepicker and timezone conversion including DST fold and gap
cells.independent_outcome: Exact UTC instant and named timezone; explicit ambiguity/gap handling

cells.behavior: Availability, options, review and controlled reservation
cells.independent_outcome: Exact slot ownership, options and durable reservation

cells.behavior: Confirmation reload and reservation retrieval
cells.independent_outcome: Same reservation identity and persisted confirmation

cells.behavior: Stale/unavailable slots and validation recovery
cells.independent_outcome: Rejected stale request; exact accepted replacement slot and request history

cells.behavior: Cancellation, interruption, retry and duplicate requests
cells.independent_outcome: No reservation on cancellation; one durable reservation after accepted retry
